question: is there a photography concentration n what classes do u take

body.answer:
Yes. The Visual Arts BA (Bachelor of Arts) offers a Photography Concentration. [1]

You take ARTS 202 BASIC SCULPTURE, ARTS 207 DIGITAL PHOTOGRAPHY, and ARTS 211 BASIC ART & TECHNOLOGY; one of ARTS 101 FUNDAMENTALS OF DRAWING or ARTS 201 BASIC PAINTING; ARHT 204 INTRODUCTION TO GLOBAL ART TRADITIONS and ARHT 245 MASTERPIECES IN WESTERN CIVILIZATION, plus one additional 300-level Art History (ARHT) course; one listed Arts Upper-level Elective; and at least three Photography Electives. [1]

Photography Lower-level Required Courses: ARHT 214 PHOTOGRAPHY CONCEPTS AND HISTORIES and ARTS 206 BLACK AND WHITE PHOTOGRAPHY. [1]

Photography Electives: choose at least three of ARTS 312 INTERMEDIATE FILM PHOTOGRAPHY, ARTS 315 MEDIUM AND LARGE FORMAT PHOTOGRAPHY, ARTS 318 INTERMEDIATE DIGITAL PHOTOGRAPHY, ARTS 324 DOCUMENTARY PHOTOGRAPHY, ARTS 328 PORTRAIT PHOTOGRAPHY, and ARTS 406 ADVANCED PHOTOGRAPHY. [1]

You also take CNTP 388 CO-OP/INTERNSHIP CONTEMPORARY ARTS and ARTS 408 SENIOR THESIS EXHIBITION. [1]

ARTS 206 BLACK AND WHITE PHOTOGRAPHY is 4 credits, has no published prerequisites, and carries Gen Ed 18-Culture & Creativity (GECC). [4] ARTS 207 DIGITAL PHOTOGRAPHY is 4 credits and has no published prerequisites. [3] ARTS 312 INTERMEDIATE FILM PHOTOGRAPHY is 4 credits; its prerequisite is ARTS 206 BLACK AND WHITE PHOTOGRAPHY. [5] ARTS 315 MEDIUM AND LARGE FORMAT PHOTOGRAPHY is 4 credits; its prerequisite is ARTS 206 BLACK AND WHITE PHOTOGRAPHY. [7] ARTS 318 INTERMEDIATE DIGITAL PHOTOGRAPHY is 4 credits; its prerequisite is ARTS 207 DIGITAL PHOTOGRAPHY. [6] ARTS 324 DOCUMENTARY PHOTOGRAPHY is 4 credits; its prerequisite is one of ARTS 206 BLACK AND WHITE PHOTOGRAPHY or ARTS 207 DIGITAL PHOTOGRAPHY. [8]

Sources: [1](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/AH-BA-ARTS) [3](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/courses/ARTS207) [4](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/courses/ARTS206) [5](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/courses/ARTS312) [6](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/courses/ARTS318) [7](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/courses/ARTS315) [8](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/courses/ARTS324)

answer:
Yes. The Visual Arts BA (Bachelor of Arts) offers a Photography Concentration. [1]

You take ARTS 202 BASIC SCULPTURE, ARTS 207 DIGITAL PHOTOGRAPHY, and ARTS 211 BASIC ART & TECHNOLOGY; one of ARTS 101 FUNDAMENTALS OF DRAWING or ARTS 201 BASIC PAINTING; ARHT 204 INTRODUCTION TO GLOBAL ART TRADITIONS and ARHT 245 MASTERPIECES IN WESTERN CIVILIZATION, plus one additional 300-level Art History (ARHT) course; one listed Arts Upper-level Elective; and at least three Photography Electives. [1]

Photography Lower-level Required Courses: ARHT 214 PHOTOGRAPHY CONCEPTS AND HISTORIES and ARTS 206 BLACK AND WHITE PHOTOGRAPHY. [1]

Photography Electives: choose at least three of ARTS 312 INTERMEDIATE FILM PHOTOGRAPHY, ARTS 315 MEDIUM AND LARGE FORMAT PHOTOGRAPHY, ARTS 318 INTERMEDIATE DIGITAL PHOTOGRAPHY, ARTS 324 DOCUMENTARY PHOTOGRAPHY, ARTS 328 PORTRAIT PHOTOGRAPHY, and ARTS 406 ADVANCED PHOTOGRAPHY. [1]

You also take CNTP 388 CO-OP/INTERNSHIP CONTEMPORARY ARTS and ARTS 408 SENIOR THESIS EXHIBITION. [1]

ARTS 206 BLACK AND WHITE PHOTOGRAPHY is 4 credits, has no published prerequisites, and carries Gen Ed 18-Culture & Creativity (GECC). [4] ARTS 207 DIGITAL PHOTOGRAPHY is 4 credits and has no published prerequisites. [3] ARTS 312 INTERMEDIATE FILM PHOTOGRAPHY is 4 credits; its prerequisite is ARTS 206 BLACK AND WHITE PHOTOGRAPHY. [5] ARTS 315 MEDIUM AND LARGE FORMAT PHOTOGRAPHY is 4 credits; its prerequisite is ARTS 206 BLACK AND WHITE PHOTOGRAPHY. [7] ARTS 318 INTERMEDIATE DIGITAL PHOTOGRAPHY is 4 credits; its prerequisite is ARTS 207 DIGITAL PHOTOGRAPHY. [6] ARTS 324 DOCUMENTARY PHOTOGRAPHY is 4 credits; its prerequisite is one of ARTS 206 BLACK AND WHITE PHOTOGRAPHY or ARTS 207 DIGITAL PHOTOGRAPHY. [8]

Sources: [1](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/AH-BA-ARTS) [3](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/courses/ARTS207) [4](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/courses/ARTS206) [5](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/courses/ARTS312) [6](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/courses/ARTS318) [7](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/courses/ARTS315) [8](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/courses/ARTS324)

answer:
The catalog does not give a total credit count for the Filmmaking BA major; its requirements list courses rather than a total [1]. The catalog says majors must total at least 40 credits and may not exceed 64 credits, including concentrations, tracks, and major-specific prerequisites [8]. The college-wide 128-credit graduation requirement is separate from the major requirement [9][10][13]. The catalog lists two bachelor's majors for film: Filmmaking BA and Theater and Film BA [14]. For the specific program requirements, contact the School of Arts, Humanities, and Education Office.

**School of Arts, Humanities, and Education Office**: Phone: (201) 684-7365. Email: AHEOffice@ramapo.edu. Office: B-224. [15]

Sources: [1](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/AH-BA-FILM) [8](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/quicklinks/academicpolicies#integrity-of-degree-programs1) [9](https://www.ramapo.edu/registrar/faq/) [10](https://www.ramapo.edu/registrar/graduation-commencement/) [13](https://www.ramapo.edu/studentsuccess/policies/) [14](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs) [15](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: how many credits to graduate w a nursing degree

body.answer:
For an undergraduate nursing degree, the minimum is 128 credits to graduate [6]. The Registrar says 32 credits must be completed at Ramapo, at least 48 credits completed there, and the final 32 in residence [6]. A program can have different requirements; the catalog’s Nursing MSN and Generic BSN requirements name courses, not a total program credit count [1][2]. For the MSN, a separate college page describes it as a 34/35-credit program [16]. The RN-to-BSN page says graduates of nursing diploma programs receive 30 credits for diploma courses after satisfactory completion of their first two BSN nursing courses [4].

**Registrar**: Phone: (201) 684-7695. Email: reg@ramapo.edu. Office: D-224. [21]

Sources: [1](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SN-MSN-NURM) [2](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SN-BSN-NURG) [4](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SN-BSN-NURS) [6](https://www.ramapo.edu/registrar/graduation-commencement/) [16](https://www.ramapo.edu/graduate/home/) [21](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

answer:
For an undergraduate nursing degree, the minimum is 128 credits to graduate [6]. The Registrar says 32 credits must be completed at Ramapo, at least 48 credits completed there, and the final 32 in residence [6]. A program can have different requirements; the catalog’s Nursing MSN and Generic BSN requirements name courses, not a total program credit count [1][2]. For the MSN, a separate college page describes it as a 34/35-credit program [16]. The RN-to-BSN page says graduates of nursing diploma programs receive 30 credits for diploma courses after satisfactory completion of their first two BSN nursing courses [4].

**Registrar**: Phone: (201) 684-7695. Email: reg@ramapo.edu. Office: D-224. [21]
